regions.description: Elongated gold-coloured flower head with pointed terminal lobes and interior divisions
Three small radial flower-like units with central ground openings
Compact striped, lobed bud-like unit; botanical identity unverified
Curved dark supporting leaf-like form with pale serrated border; this is a supporting element, not a flower

limitations: Visual descriptors are hypotheses, not a cultural motif taxonomy.
Rectangular crops can include neighbouring ornament; they do not constitute expert object segmentation.
